description: Check whether a web request really comes from the AI agent or crawler its user agent names. Give the request's User-Agent header and its IP address. Returns the claimed agent and the strongest check passed: the vendor's published IP list, reverse DNS, or a network block registered to the vendor. It cannot check request signatures. What you send is used for the check and is not stored.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address the request came from.

name: identify_request
title: Identify a web request
